reviews.t: Daughter finally wants to wash her hair
reviews.x: I have a 4 year old who screams bloody murder every time I wash her hair. She’s terrified the shampoo will get in her eyes. I bought this to see if it would help and amazingly it did!!!  I feel like it’s because she can hold the bar to lather up, gives her confidence and relieves anxiety of shampoo dripping into her eyes. It makes a very rich foamy lather that smells amazing. It doesn’t take much to produce a lather and it does not drip.  Best part is it rinses clean easily with 2 scoops of wate

My gray hair is very long and fragile. I hoped this product would be what I’ve been looking for, environmentally responsible as well as good for my hair. I just washed my hair and immediately noticed that it was very messy and in that I sat it down in a small container and it slid right out. It did lather up nicely and smelled great but once I finished, the shower the shampoo bar was a gummy mess. I towel dried my hair and as It dried It began to frizz and looked like a Halloween wig! That was e

I’m these photos I’m on day 2 of no washing. My hair is a bit messy due to humidity so don’t get me wrong, this is an amazing product. This is the third shampoo bar I’ve used. I started with J.R. Ligott’s Original bar, I finished that and moved to an off brand fermented rice bar, and now this bar. These shampoo bars are almost like washing your hair with oil, especially the J.R. Ligott’s bars, but don’t let that steer you away. My hair has never been healthier, with such great texture, and so mu

When I first heard about shampoo bars I was extremely skeptical. I have fine, dry hair and thought using a bar of soap to wash it would be very damaging. Was I wrong!!! This product lathers wonderfully, rinses easily without leaving a film, and cleans without stripping my hair. I also haven’t needed to use a conditioner (much to my surprise and delight). I comb out with a wide tooth comb and there are no knots or tangles. After blowing dry my hair is soft and manageable. I love this product!!!

reviews.t: oh the lather really surprised me
reviews.x: I had set my expectations low for replacing the usual bottles in the shower, smaller ones to lug on trips and freedom from the leaks BUT I am not going back. The lather was surprisingly instant and lush as soon as it touched my wet hair. A dab of leave in conditioner after towel drying makes my fine hair healthy and happy.

I've only used it for a week and I've been loving it. It is the only shampoo bar that hasn't completely stripped my hair. Hopefully it continues to work for my hair.  I have fine oily hair with atopic dermatitis which most shampoos and conditioners make my skin flair up and so far so good.  Im loving this I really hope they come out with companion conditioner bars that do a good job at conditioning your hair. I'm still looking for a good conditioner bar.

First off rinses insanely easy! The smell on the oat one can be a little strong. I have fine thin hair and it does not weigh it down.  However I have very hard water here where I live. I use a filter on my showerhead. It almost seems like it leaves a film. This would probably be suited better for people with softer water.
I took a chance on this and was pleasantly surprised. Softened my colored hair better than my expensive products.

reviews.t: I wanted to love it but...
reviews.x: I wanted to love this bar shampoo because it does not use plastic and it will be easy to travel with.  The bar is not as wide as the box and it is in a tear shape so it's easy to hold.  I did not like the smell-I tend to be sensitive to smells.  The bar feels very solid in your hand.  I thought it would  lather up better in my hand.  I wet my hair in the shower and applied it to the roots of my hair and worked it outward.  It required that I add additional water to my hair to lather up whereas b

reviews.x: I’ve been on a hunt for a shampoo bar for awhile now, because I love the simplicity of traveling with one. I’ve tried a few bars, but this one’s definitely the winner for me! I’ve had my bar for almost two months now and I’m still getting use out of it and I love it! I have waist length fine hair and hard water. Some of the CP bars I purchase and some I made. Then I tried a lot of syndet bars, which this one falls under. I purchased and made my own. None of them left my hair in comparable shape to using s bottle shampoo, except for this one. Except it’s even better! My hair is soft, silky and shiny. I have  bra

reviews.t: Shampoo bars for the win for travel!
reviews.x: I was quite skeptical about a shampoo bar. Would it lather? Would it leave my hair smooth and shiny? We were trying different brands for an upcoming trip and I am now a shampoo bar convert! It is as good or better than shampoo in a bottle and for travel, there is no question it is the best choice. We bought two different bars of Garnier. The scent was lovely, and the lather exceeded my expectations. My husband said he rather use a shampoo bar from now on. The only thing was the length of time it

Have been using this bar for over a month now. I have fine, thinish hair. We have a whole house water softener system, otherwise we would have very hard water. Now with that out of the way, I love how the bar lathers up and cleans my hair. No residue and no need for a conditioner after. I rub the bar on my hands rather than directly onto my head, making sure I have lots of water in my hair so that the lather is evenly distributed throughout my hair. This method works very well for me. It rinses

I have veryy short hair that I wash daily as my skin/hair is on the oily side. This shampoo is very hydrating, doesn't dry it out even with daily use. For me, it works as a two-in-one, no need for conditioner. I wash my baby's hair without conditioner with this also. Love the lack of plastic and the price.

I have baby fine hair and I've had to use shampoos with conditions then leave in conditions....what a process.  With this shampoo BAR my hear cleaned easily, no residue and I only needed about 1/3 the amount of leave in conditioner that I used to use.  No frizzies .

I have been losing hair like crazy since my multiple surgeries 2016-2019. I am 44 and had a full hysterectomy at age 36. I tried Purador with no success. I then switched to a 3 in 1 shampoo/ body a couple of months ago which I found at my local health food co-op. I received great results with this! Keeping it simple and natural with my hair washing routine. I haven't emptied my brush in over a month. I know, gross, but I wanted to see how much hair I was losing. Hardly any. This shampoo bar is a

This is a very nice shampoo bar. This seems to be the new craze I’m only going to give this one a four-star because I feel like it’s not gonna last two months like it says on the packaging I have medium to long hair and it takes quite a bit of rubbing that’s on in order to feel like I’ve got a good lather going. The price seems pretty comparable to other products out there and it’s definitely worth the try if I had shorter hair maybe it would last longer I’m not sure. It’s made with natural ingr

This product claims to be a softening shampoo. It left my hair dry and brittle. I was very disappointed as I've used Garnier Whole Blend products for years and they are still effective. Another big disappointment was the packaging. The bar is actually smaller than you'd think when you look at the package because when you open the box, there is a 3/4" cardboard "divider" (for lack of a better word) that removes 3/4" of space inside the box. The bar fits snugly in the rest of the area and doesn't

this is a great product. I will buy again and again. Have used it about 2 months and feel I will easily get another 2 mo use out of it. I have short hair and wash it every 1-2 days depending on situations. Greatly appreciate there is no plastic involved. Took a few uses to get used to the change from a squeeze of shampoo to the use of a "bar" of shampoo. Smell is light and does not linger which works for me and allergies. Best part is my fine hair is shiny until I wash it again, does not dry out

I was looking for a bar shampoo that I could put into carry-on luggage that TSA wouldnt count against my 3-1-1 liquids.  This did the trick and worked great!  Ive had other bar shampoos and they didnt lather like this one does and it smells great.  It didnt dry out my hair or leave residue and I just added a leave in conditioner when I got out of the shower and whala perfect clean and shiny hair.

I was interested in purchasing a shampoo bar for an upcoming trip via plane to cut down on liquid toiletries going through security.  It lathers well and doesn't dry my scalp or hair out. It is also a well known brand and half the cost of the other shampoo bars on the market.

reviews.t: Works well on fine, straight hair
reviews.x: I have been looking for a consistently effective shampoo bar, and I am surprised (pleasantly so) that a big company came through. I have straight hair that has zero texture and tends to be oily, and this works great! My hair is colored and I see no evidence that this strips out the color. Lasts a long while if you can keep it out of the shower stream. Clean and feels conditioned after use. I will continue to purchase!

This was my first ever try for shampoo bar. I didn't like it at all, my hair felt very sticky and weird after. Took me a few times of use to realize if I lather and wash twice my hair will look clean and feel soft. I also realized I have to keep it very dry between uses or it gets soggy. Has very little delicate smell, personally I prefer much stronger one. Overall great experience and will try their other ones.

Firstly, this scent is so incredibly overpowering that my whole bathroom smells like flowers, even a month after first use. (Fortunately, it's not a bad scent, but would be concerning to people who are sensitive to scents.)  It works well as a shampoo, lathers the same as other bars. No other difference. Price point? You're paying for the name and the HEAVY perfume.

It does the job really well. Leaves all of our hair soft and clean. Zero plastic waste is a huge plus. That said, these products need to be significantly cheaper if more and more people are to be persuaded to switch.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the bar lathers surprisingly well and rinses easily without leaving residue.
Several reviewers with fine or thin hair report it cleans without stripping or weighing hair down.
Some reviewers find the scent too strong or off-putting, especially those sensitive to smells.
A few reviewers mention a film or frizz, particularly with hard water or fragile gray hair.
Multiple reviewers praise it for travel and reducing plastic use.
